account.notes:
SOURCE OF TRUTH: the developer's own SharePoint share, one folder per project. The link is a
bearer credential (anonymous 'anyone with the link' access, no sign-in) and is therefore kept
ONLY in DeveloperAccount.developerCloudUrl, never in this repo — same rule as Korantina and
Patroclos. Pass it once via PDOM_CLOUD_URL when running the sync, or set it in the admin.

SCOPE. The share covers only the three Universal, Paphos projects: AZUR, NOVA and THE MEADOWS.
AZUR and NOVA have real per-unit price lists (both dated 05/11/2026) and get real units.

THE MEADOWS is imported WITHOUT units on purpose. The only document that exists for it is an
architectural design concept by DMSTAR/TAD dated 08/12/2025 — no price list, no availability.
That document also records that the plots allow a MAXIMUM OF 2 FLOORS / 10 m while the client
asked for 4, and lists the planning-permission refusal as an open risk. The website meanwhile
shows THE MEADOWS as 'Under Construction'. Those two cannot both be current; stage is set to
the defensible 'Off Plan' until the developer confirms. Unit mix in the facts is the CONCEPT's
plan (24 apartments + 4 townhouses + a beauty salon), not a sold product.

NOT IMPORTED, and why:
  - Nerida Residences, Chloraka — 7 villas, marked COMPLETED on the developer's own 'Our Work'
    page and built together with AGG Luxury Homes (who already have a developer page with us).
    No folder in the share, no availability, no prices. Ask before importing: a completed joint
    project may be all sold, and it must not end up duplicated under two developers.
  - Villa in Tala 1 and Villa in Tala 2 — one-off private houses built for a client, shown as
    reference work. Villa in Tala 2 has no text on the website at all. Not sellable products.

NAME COLLISIONS, flagged 2026-11-05: we already carry 'Nova' (Reiwa Development, Tombs of the
Kings, slug 'nova'), so PDOM's NOVA Residence must not take that slug. We also carry 'Azure
Beachfront Villas' (Aristo) and 'Azure Living' (Medousa), which read almost like AZUR.

AREAS. areaInternal/areaBuilt carry the PURE interior figure. The developer's 'Total built area'
column is internal + covered terraces + green zone + installations area and goes into attrs, so
the page's Covered Area does not double-count it. Roof terraces are NOT inside that total.
VAT is charged on top of every price; the lists state the prices already include the agent's
commission.

Monthly: re-download the two price lists, re-transcribe here (every row must still add up to the
list's own total — the script refuses otherwise), dry run, then --apply.

projects.name: AZUR Residence
amenities: One private parking space per apartment
Double-glazed, thermally insulated aluminium windows with provisions for mosquito nets
facts: One block of three floors with six two-bedroom apartments, all en-suite.
Third-floor apartments add a 45 m² private roof terrace.
Kitchens and wardrobes by GF Interiors, Italy; white goods are not included.
Bedroom floors in oak parquet, living and common areas in 1000 × 1000 mm anti-slip ceramic tiles, bathroom walls in 1200 × 600 mm ceramic tiles.
Internal doors by Garofoli, Italy, 2100 mm high; aluminium windows by Muskita.
Sanitary ware by Ideal Standard, kitchen sinks and mixers by Franke.
Prices are quoted plus VAT and already include the agent's commission.

projects.name: NOVA Residence
amenities: One private parking space per apartment
Private balconies, and roof terraces on the top floor
facts: One block of three floors with six two-bedroom apartments.
Both third-floor apartments face the sea and add a private roof terrace of 47–49 m².
Prices are quoted plus VAT and already include the agent's commission.

projects.name: THE MEADOWS
amenities: Communal swimming pool and children's splash zone
facts: Planned as two blocks on six adjoining plots of 3,988 m² in total, with a park between them.
The design concept of 08/12/2025 plans 24 apartments in Block A — one-, two- and three-bedroom — plus four townhouses and a beauty salon in Block B.
No price list and no availability exist yet; the figures above come from the design concept, not from a sales list.
